content.short: Hanji is an onchain central limit order book exchange on Monad with zero maker fees.
content.description: Hanji runs a central limit order book fully on-chain on Monad, charging no maker fees and relying on low gas costs to make order placement and cancellation economical. On-chain order books were impractical on Ethereum because every cancellation cost real money, which is exactly the constraint chains like Monad are built to remove.
content.meta: A fully onchain order book on Monad, practical because cancelling an order costs almost nothing.
